lessonTitle: 42. Tangency of solids of revolution with each other, planes and lines
lessonTitleEnglish: Tangency of solids of revolution with each other, planes and lines
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: A line touches a sphere if they have one common point; then the line is perpendicular to the radius at that point.
stages.headlineEnglish: A line touches a sphere if they have one common point; then the line is perpendicular to the radius at that point.

stages.headline: Two spheres touch if they have one common point: externally (O₁O₂ = R₁ + R₂) or internally (O₁O₂ = |R₁ − R₂|).
stages.headlineEnglish: Two spheres touch if they have one common point: externally (O₁O₂ = R₁ + R₂) or internally (O₁O₂ = |R₁ − R₂|).

stages.headline: A ball fits inside a cylinder when h = 2R; then the sphere touches both bases and the lateral surface.
stages.headlineEnglish: A ball fits inside a cylinder when h = 2R; then the sphere touches both bases and the lateral surface.
